design_rule: Each Game uses the minimum necessary mechanism bundle. Shared world does not imply shared game mechanics.

games.objective: Reconstruct what combination of data snapshot, version, pipeline and workflow produced the suspicious outputs.
skill_expression: forming competing causal hypotheses
preserving evidence before acting
choosing which jurisdiction to unlock next
distinguishing correlation from causal explanation
tracking who knew what when
games.anti_pattern: Do not let Zhou Ye or any technical actor become an omniscient debugger.

games.objective: Produce a defensible preliminary explanation under deadline without converting uncertainty into false certainty.
skill_expression: drafting claims whose evidential strength matches the record
choosing what to omit without misleading
building a coalition around a statement
recognizing when a caveat is protective versus evasive
using public commitments as leverage
games.anti_pattern: Do not make the cautious faction automatically morally superior.

games.objective: Determine how the screenshot moved outside the project and what, if anything, that implies about motive or responsibility.
skill_expression: testing claims against timestamps and access paths
using private conversations without contaminating evidence
distinguishing self-protective forwarding from sabotage
deciding when disclosure is a costly signal
managing reputation spillover
games.anti_pattern: Do not collapse the leak into a secret villain reveal.

games.objective: Choose whether the pilot pauses, narrows or continues before complete certainty exists.
skill_expression: coalition building
trading scope for safety or speed
allocating manual review capacity
using authority without exhausting legitimacy
anticipating how today's compromise constrains the next Game
games.anti_pattern: Do not let the formally highest-ranking actor decide without coalition or downstream cost.

event_arc_variety_goal: The four Games should feel strategically different while remaining causally coupled through explicit cross-game bridges.
